shellCommands.command: git status --short && ls -la && cat package.json 2>/dev/null; find . -path ./node_modules -prune -o -type f -print | grep -v "^./.git/" | head -100

cat src/App.tsx; echo ----; cat src/main.tsx; echo ----; cat src/vite-env.d.ts; echo ----; cat tsconfig.json; echo ----; cat AGENTS.md; echo ----; cat .gitignore; echo ----; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json | grep '"version"'; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs 2>/dev/null | head; echo ----; cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md | head -150

sed -n 150,400p .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md; echo ----; cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh | head -60; echo ----; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/dist 2>/dev/null | head -30

rg -n -i "modal|dialog|confirm" .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md | head -30; echo ----; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build | head -50; echo ----; rg -n -i "dialog|modal" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/README.md | head; echo ----; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Dialog 2>/dev/null; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Modal 2>/dev/null

sed -n 25,40p .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md; echo ....; sed -n 165,185p .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md; echo ....; rg -n -B2 -A8 "ConfirmDialog|components\`|@gravity-ui/components" .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md | head -80
npm view @gravity-ui/components version peerDependencies dependencies 2>&1 | head -60

for v in $(npm view @gravity-ui/components versions --json 2>/dev/null | tr -d '[]," ' | grep -E '^[0-9]' | sort -V | tail -40); do echo "$v $(npm view @gravity-ui/components@$v peerDependencies.@gravity-ui/uikit 2>/dev/null)"; done
npm install --save-exact @gravity-ui/components@4.23.1 2>&1 | tail -15 && node -e 'console.log(require("./node_modules/@gravity-ui/components/package.json").version)' && git diff --stat

P=node_modules/@gravity-ui/components; ls $P; ls $P/dist/docs 2>/dev/null || ls $P/build/docs 2>/dev/null; rg -l "ConfirmDialog" $P --glob '*.d.ts' | head; echo ----; rg -n "ConfirmDialog" $P/README.md | head

P=node_modules/@gravity-ui/components/build/esm/components/ConfirmDialog; cat $P/ConfirmDialog.d.ts; echo ----; cat $P/index.d.ts; echo ----; grep -n "ConfirmDialog" node_modules/@gravity-ui/components/build/esm/components/index.d.ts; echo ----; rg -n "ConfirmDialog" node_modules/@gravity-ui/components/build/esm/index.d.ts 2>/dev/null; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/components/build/esm | head -30

cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/components/build/esm/index.d.ts; echo ----; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/components/build/esm/components/ConfirmDialog/ConfirmDialog.js 2>/dev/null | head -60; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/components/build/esm/components/ConfirmDialog/; echo ----; rg -n "open|onClose|title" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Dialog/Dialog.d.ts | head -20

wc -l node_modules/@gravity-ui/components/README.md && rg -n -i -A6 "setup|install|style" node_modules/@gravity-ui/components/README.md | head -60; echo ----; rg -n "textButtonApply|textButtonCancel|onClickButtonApply|onClickButtonCancel|propsButtonApply|propsButtonCancel|preset" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Dialog/DialogFooter/DialogFooter.d.ts | head -20
npx tsc --noEmit; echo "tsc exit=$?"; npx vite build --outDir /tmp/gui-build-check --emptyOutDir 2>&1 | tail -8; echo "vite exit=${PIPESTATUS[0]}"
